summary.headline: Hephaestion Chapter Catalogue
summary.text: Catalog of Hephaestion chapters on astrological techniques and omens, including conjunctions, enclosure, radiation, decanates, spearbearing, dodecatemories, inceptions, planetary lordship, signs, eclipses, comets, the Dog Star, and conception horoscoping, with Florentine folio references. The notes identify Paris codex 2417, Kroll’s collation, Engelbrecht’s index, and a parallel in Ptolemy’s Tetrabiblos.
